facts.text: Located on 400 acres alongside Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve, near Torrey Pines and Carmel Valley.
facts.excerpt: located on 400 acres alongside Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve near Torrey Pines and Carmel Valley

facts.text: Grounds include a grove of eucalyptus trees and a waterfall cascading through ancient volcanic rock.
facts.excerpt: walk amidst a grove of eucalyptus trees and marvel over a waterfall cascading through ancient volcanic rock.

facts.text: The resort offers about two dozen weekly outdoor activities, including hiking, horseback trail rides, yoga, meditation and archery.
facts.excerpt: Explore two dozen weekly outdoor activities including hiking, horseback trailrides, yoga, meditation and archery.

facts.text: The resort has an 18-hole private golf course designed by Tom Fazio.
Addison by William Bradley is a Michelin three-star restaurant at the resort.
facts.excerpt: the culinary artistry of Addison by William Bradley, San Diego’s first and only Michelin three-star restaurant.

facts.text: Amaya serves refined California-Mediterranean cuisine, casual poolside fare and inventive cocktails during happy hour.
facts.excerpt: Amaya offers refined California-Mediterranean cuisine, casual poolside fare, and inventive cocktails during happy hour.

facts.text: The spa is a wellness facility of 21,000 square feet with massages, hydrotherapy, aromatherapy and restorative lounges.
facts.excerpt: features a 21,000-square-foot wellness facility with massages, hydrotherapy, aromatherapy, and restorative lounges before and after treatments.

facts.text: The spa also has saunas, whirlpools, steam rooms and an adults-only relaxation pool.
facts.excerpt: Other amenities include saunas, whirlpools, steam rooms, and an adults-only relaxation pool.

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas have marble bathrooms, large balconies or terraces, and views of the gardens, the golf club or the canyon preserve.
facts.excerpt: spacious marble bathrooms, expansive balconies or terraces, and spectacular views of the gardens, Grand Golf Club, or Canyon Preserve.

facts.text: The Signature Poolside room is adults-only, on the ground floor, with a patio with fireside seating and direct access to the relaxation pool.
facts.excerpt: Adults-only room located on ground floor with large patio with fireside seating, direct access to relaxation pool

facts.text: Villa Sorrento is a secluded one-story villa with three master bedrooms, each with a private bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Secluded, spacious one story Villa with three master bedrooms with private bathroom each.

facts.text: Larger suites and villas suit families or extended stays.
facts.excerpt: Larger suites and villas are ideal for families or extended stays

facts.text: Guests are described as couples celebrating anniversaries, golf and spa enthusiasts, and families staying several days rather than making quick city stops.
facts.excerpt: couples celebrating anniversaries, golf and spa enthusiasts, and families enjoying multiple days of pampering and onsite activities rather than quick city stops.

facts.text: The resort is not beachfront, though it is close to Del Mar's beaches, boutique shopping and surf breaks for light day trips.
facts.excerpt: While not beachfront, the resort is close to Del Mar’s beautiful beaches, boutique shopping, and world-class surf breaks if you’re up for light day trips.

facts.text: Torrey Pines State Reserve trails, Del Mar racetrack events and the One Paseo culinary district are nearby.
facts.excerpt: Nearby, you can explore Torrey Pines State Reserve trails, Del Mar racetrack events, and the vibrant One Paseo culinary district.

facts.text: Grand Social seasonal outdoor events with lawn games, live music and craft cocktails take place during the summer months.
facts.excerpt: Grand Social seasonal outdoor events offer lawn games, live music, and craft cocktails during the summer months.

facts.text: Fitness classes are complimentary for resort guests.
facts.excerpt: fitness classes are complimentary for resort guests

facts.text: The concierge can arrange golf tee times, spa experiences, private excursions and dining reservations.
facts.excerpt: Concierge can arrange golf tee times, spa experiences, private excursions, and dining reservations

facts.text: Guests can play tennis or pickleball on the resort's courts.
